name: Kiribati Digital Government Project (P176108) - Containerized National Data Center & Government Cloud Equipment (Phase 2)
developer: Government of Kiribati / Ministry of Information, Communications and Transport (MICT) with World Bank (IDA) financing
notes: Procurement-stage government data center + government cloud under the World Bank-financed Kiribati Digital Government Project (P176108) in South Tarawa (Gilbert Islands). World Bank Stakeholder Engagement Plan (A) states the project's only physical construction is 'the installation of a National Data Center in South Tarawa, co-located with the cable landing station or in Bairiki village' (administrative capital). World Bank 2026-03-13 procurement plan lists Phase 2 'KI-MICTTD-470992-GO-RFQ' (Containerized Data Center and Government Cloud Equipment Phase 2) as Pending Implementation (~US$900,000); tender mirrors (deepbloo, C-grade lead) show publication 14 Mar 2026 and 2026-03-31 submission deadline. MICT KDGP page (A) confirms project scope and Tarawa location. No award/delivery published as of 2026-08-12; do not count as built until commissioned.

name: EMCS East Micronesia Cable System - Tarawa/Nanikai Cable Landing Station
developer: BwebwerikiNet Limited (BNL) / EMCS project (funded by Australia AIFFP, Japan, USA); NEC Corporation (contractor)
notes: Cable landing station (asset class: cable landing / interconnection anchor, NOT a datacenter). EMCS (2,250 km, Tarawa-Nauru-Kosrae-Pohnpei) landed at South Tarawa 2025-07-25 (BNL blog); NEC press release 2026-05-15 (A) announces construction completed and handover to BNL. GeoCables lists RFS expected 2026 with current operational status unconfirmed - re-check retail/ready-for-service status before marking live. First submarine cable to South Tarawa; interconnection evidence that could enable future facilities, not a datacenter itself.

name: Vodafone Kiribati (ATHKL) core/network sites
developer: Vodafone Kiribati (Amalgamated Telecom Holdings Kiribati - ATH)
notes: Telco core / server-room lead (asset class: telco-core), not verified colocation. Incumbent operator (ATH acquired TSKL assets 2015) with core network in South Tarawa and presence on Kiritimati; JICA/Yachiyo survey (Feb 2026) reports South Tarawa sites upgraded to 4G+ with 5G-core readiness being prepared. A-grade for operator existence; no colocation/hosting facility claim verified (facility details C).

name: Ocean Link Ltd core/network sites
notes: Telco core / server-room lead (asset class: telco-core), not verified colocation. Second operator, operational since 2018/2019 (GSMA membership; TeleGeography-derived launch history via Samena Council); JICA identifies active role in South Tarawa and remote-island mobile projects (incl. Kiritimati). A-grade for operator existence; no hosting/colocation facility claim verified (facility details C).

name: Southern Cross NEXT Kiritimati spur - Tabwakea Cable Landing Station
developer: Southern Cross Cable Network; landing station operated by BwebwerikiNet Limited (BNL)
notes: Cable landing station (asset class: cable landing / interconnection anchor, NOT a datacenter). Dedicated 377 km one-fibre-pair branch of Southern Cross NEXT to Tabwakea, Kiritimati (Line Islands), in service since July 2022; BNL operates/maintains the CLS (ADB IEE 50348-001; BNL LinkedIn; Submarine Networks; GeoCables). Station serves both Vodafone and Ocean Link mobile services on Kiritimati. NO datacenter facility or DC proposal verified in the Line Islands as of 2026-08-12 (diesel/solar power limits, no public proposal); World Bank US$110M Kiritimati growth grant (Feb 2025) is transport/economic-development context, not a datacenter project.

No datacenter/server-farm/telecom-infrastructure project found in targeted searches (Kanton/Abariringa, Phoenix Islands Protected Area). Only permanent settlement is Kanton with ~28 residents (2026); no power grid or telecom hub; searches returned only geography/tourism/PIPA content. Negative result recorded per methodology (no_projects).
